name: phd-track-note-needs-a-university
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: the §3.5 track note used to treat a transfer row with NO university named as Notre Dame coursework, so it told the student the course "counts here in full" while the course line and the credit totals — which go through isNotreDameInstitution — counted nothing. The note now uses the same test the engine does, so it stays quiet on a row whose university is blank (the manual course form does not require one).
